semantic_source.primary: FILE/mac.afs and unsuffixed Japanese UI assets
semantic_source.fallback: English only when Japanese cannot supply the meaning, including presentation lines stored in English inside the Japanese build and English-only Gestalt Special Mode text.

source_encoding: CP932 / Shift-JIS in decompressed scenario bytecode
target_encoding: CP932 technical carrier map with custom Hangul glyphs in FNT2626.FOP

display_exceptions.reason: Preserved English-slot transient/floating glyph bank; excluded from Hangul carriers

display_exceptions.rule: Only undefined slots and unused CJK ideograph slots may be repurposed; punctuation, kana, Latin, spacing, and technical glyphs are protected

asset_edit_rule: Do not paint Korean over source text; remove source glyphs and recreate the affected asset at identical canvas size, aspect ratio, and placement.
font: Noto Sans KR variable font, weight 500 at the original 34 px full-width cell; original advance, line height, and placement preserved; raster UI Medium 500
control_code_policy: Preserve Japanese-source control sequences. Do not force a dialogue color: retain the PC original's default light glyph body and dark edge pass. Never add color commands to choice records because the choice renderer exposes them literally.

provenance.translation_method: Japanese-context semantic translation written by Codex internal; no external translation model or API used.
